tasks.title: Organize the repository and executable backlog
tasks.acceptance: Task graph checks and tooling tests pass; task ownership and evidence are documented.
tasks.verification: See docs/development/FOUNDATION-RESULTS.md

tasks.title: Prototype the everyday and advanced desktop journeys
tasks.acceptance: Browser walkthrough covers add, media quality, pause/resume, filtering, power mode, keyboard dialog; simulation is clear.
tasks.verification: See docs/development/FOUNDATION-RESULTS.md

tasks.title: Build local HTTP fixtures and baseline harness
tasks.acceptance: Range/ETag/fault tests pass; two curl runs record independent matching hashes. No comparative claim.
tasks.verification: See docs/development/FOUNDATION-RESULTS.md

tasks.title: Prove native HTTP backend packaging and capabilities
tasks.acceptance: Package a minimal Rust/libcurl candidate with reproducible H1/H2/H3 capability checks, TLS trust, proxy, cancellation and clean native build evidence.
tasks.verification: Tracked Rust/libcurl spike builds with a lockfile and passes controlled H1, public TLS, explicit proxy, and bounded cancellation checks. Runtime feature detection correctly fails the HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 capability gate; protocol transfers remain not-run.

tasks.title: Define job commands, events and identity contract
tasks.acceptance: Specify states/errors, cancellation, progress, trusted versus observed hashes, bounded buffers, and publication contract. Strong-model review.
tasks.verification: Accepted contract covers states/errors, cancellation and publication fencing, identity provenance, progress streams, bounded buffers, checkpoints and restart. Independent Astra High/high adversarial review passed after corrections.

tasks.title: Prove browser handoff compatibility
tasks.acceptance: Document Chrome/Edge/Firefox GET/auth/POST/blob/signed-URL matrix and acknowledged handoff/fallback using real supported browser APIs.
tasks.verification: Document Chrome/Edge/Firefox GET/auth/POST/blob/signed-URL matrix and acknowledged handoff/fallback using real supported browser APIs.

tasks.title: Prove media extraction and helper packaging
tasks.acceptance: Select first site/format corpus; record yt-dlp/FFmpeg and runtime dependencies, muxed output, cancellation, errors, update and license requirements.
tasks.verification: Select first site/format corpus; record yt-dlp/FFmpeg and runtime dependencies, muxed output, cancellation, errors, update and license requirements.

tasks.title: Choose desktop framework from Windows UX spike
tasks.acceptance: Compare no more than two credible candidates for accessibility, startup/RSS, tray lifecycle, native integration and installer; record supported Windows target decision.
tasks.verification: Compare no more than two credible candidates for accessibility, startup/RSS, tray lifecycle, native integration and installer; record supported Windows target decision.

tasks.title: Download one HTTP file through the native core
tasks.acceptance: Real URL to staging file to validated safe publication; fixture byte check; bounded memory, cancellation, native build/test.
tasks.verification: Real URL to staging file to validated safe publication; fixture byte check; bounded memory, cancellation, native build/test.

tasks.title: Connect the desktop add-download flow to the core
tasks.acceptance: Real desktop download with destination/progress/cancel/completion; no simulated jobs in production path.
tasks.verification: Real desktop download with destination/progress/cancel/completion; no simulated jobs in production path.

tasks.title: Implement recoverable checkpoints and safe resume
tasks.acceptance: Fault injection at write/flush/commit/publication; changed ETag, refused range, truncation, disk full and restart remain correct.
tasks.verification: Fault injection at write/flush/commit/publication; changed ETag, refused range, truncation, disk full and restart remain correct.

tasks.title: Ship usable queues, schedules and recovery UX
tasks.acceptance: Batch preview, schedules after sleep, conflict handling, history, search, tray and actionable errors; coherent keyboard flow.
tasks.verification: Batch preview, schedules after sleep, conflict handling, history, search, tray and actionable errors; coherent keyboard flow.

tasks.title: Implement browser extension and authenticated capture
tasks.acceptance: Supported requests hand off without loss/duplicates, secrets stay scoped, unsupported requests stay in browser, exclusions work.
tasks.verification: Supported requests hand off without loss/duplicates, secrets stay scoped, unsupported requests stay in browser, exclusions work.

tasks.title: Implement launch media downloads and quality selection
tasks.acceptance: Real selected-quality video/audio output, mux verification, cancellation, helper crash and expired-session recovery; first release requirement.
tasks.verification: Real selected-quality video/audio output, mux verification, cancellation, helper crash and expired-session recovery; first release requirement.

tasks.title: Implement measured adaptive HTTP transfers
tasks.acceptance: Global budgets, H2/H3 fallback, identical workloads and raw comparative evidence; no speed claim from loopback alone.
tasks.verification: Global budgets, H2/H3 fallback, identical workloads and raw comparative evidence; no speed claim from loopback alone.

tasks.title: Extend compatibility to FTP, FTPS and SFTP
tasks.acceptance: Real protocol auth/resume/certificate/host-key fixtures; errors and supported capabilities documented.
tasks.verification: Real protocol auth/resume/certificate/host-key fixtures; errors and supported capabilities documented.

tasks.title: Harden Windows UX and packaging
tasks.acceptance: Accessibility, install/update/uninstall, retained queues, native compatibility; settle distribution/license and signing before publication.
tasks.verification: Accessibility, install/update/uninstall, retained queues, native compatibility; settle distribution/license and signing before publication.

tasks.title: Validate first public release candidate
tasks.acceptance: Independent acceptance matrix, compatibility corpus, benchmark uncertainty, known limitations and documented release decision.
tasks.verification: Independent acceptance matrix, compatibility corpus, benchmark uncertainty, known limitations and documented release decision.

tasks.title: Add Metalink and verified multi-source repair
tasks.acceptance: Trusted piece hashes enable selective repair; final-only hash behavior honest; bad/slow/offline mirrors tested.
tasks.verification: Trusted piece hashes enable selective repair; final-only hash behavior honest; bad/slow/offline mirrors tested.

tasks.title: Add bounded content cache and paired LAN mode
tasks.acceptance: Authorized offline reuse, explicit pairing/sharing, eviction and quota tests; no private-content leakage.
tasks.verification: Authorized offline reuse, explicit pairing/sharing, eviction and quota tests; no private-content leakage.

tasks.acceptance: Coordinate libtorrent piece policy and global quotas; explicit upload/discovery controls and malformed-input tests.
tasks.verification: Coordinate libtorrent piece policy and global quotas; explicit upload/discovery controls and malformed-input tests.

tasks.verification: Provider auth/version identity correct; compare to official client, including Xet where applicable.
